title: Latenrgy: Model Agnostic Latency and Energy Consumption Prediction for Binary Classifiers
reasoning: The paper focuses on the computational overhead (latency and energy consumption) of implementing Responsible AI (RAI) guardrails. While it mentions ethical principles like fairness and transparency as the motivation for these guardrails, it does not evaluate, benchmark, or study religion, morals, or ethical reasoning itself; rather, it provides a mathematical framework for predicting the performance impact of those technical controls.
